name: 实现 DeploymentService (part 1)
description:
实现 DeploymentService 服务方法: createDeployment, getDeployment, listDeployments
  - createDeployment: (request: CreateDeploymentRequest, actor: String) -> CreateDeploymentResponse pre=project_id 对应的项目存在且未软删除；environment_id 对应的环境存在且状态为 online；该 
  - getDeployment: (deploymentId: UUID) -> DeploymentDetailResponse pre=部署记录存在且未被软删除
  - listDeployments: (projectId: UUID, page: Integer, pageSize: Integer) -> PaginatedResult pre=page ≥ 1，pageSize ∈ [1, 100]，项目存在
